_comments.purpose: Firefox enterprise policies for the benchmark VM. The suite setup writes the 'policies' object to /etc/firefox/policies/policies.json. They stop pop-ups and extra pages that the model would otherwise have to dismiss, so that the Firefox tests measure the task, not dialog handling.
_comments.OverrideFirstRunPage: No 'Welcome to Firefox' tab on the first start.
_comments.OverridePostUpdatePage: No 'What's new' tab after an update.
_comments.DontCheckDefaultBrowser: No 'Make Firefox your default browser?' bar.
_comments.DisableTelemetry: No telemetry, and no data-sharing notice on the first run.
_comments.UserMessaging: No onboarding wizard and no extension, feature or 'More from Mozilla' recommendations.
_comments.browser.sessionstore.resume_from_crash: The suite setup stops Firefox with pkill after its first start, which Firefox treats as a crash. Without this, the next start offers to restore the old tabs instead of opening a clean browser. 'locked' stops the page from changing it.
